title: Fluorescence in situ hybridization \(FISH) for DNA replication origins
protocol: Clean slides with 70% ethanol.
Place a few drops of pellet on the slide and let air dry.
Incubate the slide at 90°C for one hour and a half or at 37°C overnight.
Store aged slides at -20°C if needed for later use.
After 1.5 hours in the incubator, let the slide cool.
Add 150-200 μl of 0.005% Pepsin/0.001M HCl and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Place slides in a coplin jar with PBS 1x for 5 min.
Wash slides in post fixation solution for 5 min.
Wash slides in Paraformaldehyde/PBS for 5 min.
Wash slides in PBS 1x for 5 min.
Incubate slides in ethanol series: 70%, 90%, and 100% (slides can be left in 100% ethanol until ready to be hybridized).
Take out slides before hybridization with probe and let air dry completely.
Mix 3 μl of Salmon Sperm DNA (SSD) with the sample.
Add 10 μl of Cot-1 DNA to the mixture.
Combine 1/10 volume of NaAC with the mixture.
Add 3 volumes of cold EtOH to precipitate the sample.
Place the eppendorf at -80°C for 15 minutes or at -20°C for at least 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the eppendorf at +4°C for 20 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and dry the pellet using a Savant centrifuge if available.
Resuspend the dried pellet in Hybridization Mix.
Place the mixture in a thermomixer at room temperature for 10 minutes to mix thoroughly.
Apply the probes on dried slides.
Place a coverslip over the probes and seal it with rubber cement.
Insert the slides into Hybrite (Vysis) and initiate the cycle.
Set Hybrite temperatures: Melt at 69°C for 2 minutes, Hybridize at 37°C overnight.
Remove the coverslip from the slide for re-hybridization.
Place the slide in a solution of 2x SSC at 42°C for 2 hours.
Rinse in PBS at room temperature.
Place slide for 5 minutes in each of the following ethanol solutions: 70%, 90%, 100%.
Decrease denaturation time.
Melt at 69°C for 1 minute (for human slides).
Hybridize overnight at 37°C.
Wash three times at 57°C in 0.1x SSC for 5 minutes each.
Incubate for 5 minutes in DAPI solution (60 ml of 2x SSC, 120 μl DAPI).
Add a few drops of Antifade DABCO on the coverslip and ensure there are no air bubbles between slide and coverslip.
Analyze with LEICA DMRXA Fluorescent microscope.
